passage:
Lingua Bridge Institute — Spring Brochure
Lingua Bridge Institute offers evening Spanish courses at four levels: Beginner (A1), Elementary (A2), Intermediate (B1), and Advanced (B2). All new students must take a free online placement test before enrolling. Classes meet twice a week for ten weeks. Tuition is $320 per course; students who enroll in two consecutive terms receive a 15% discount on the second term. The spring term begins on March 9, and enrollment closes on March 2.

--- Passage 2 ---
Lingua Bridge Institute — Placement Test Result
Name: Daniel Okafor
Test date: February 18
Listening: 72/100, Reading: 81/100, Grammar: 76/100
Overall band: B1 (Intermediate)
Recommendation: You are eligible to enroll in the Intermediate (B1) course. If you find the level too challenging during the first week, you may transfer to Elementary (A2) at no charge. This result is valid for six months.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: enrollment@linguabridge.com
From: d.okafor@parkmail.com
Date: February 25
Subject: Spring enrollment

Dear Enrollment Office,
I completed my placement test last week and would like to register for the course recommended in my result letter for the spring term. I also plan to continue with the next level in the summer term, so please confirm that the discount mentioned in your brochure will apply to my summer tuition. In addition, my employer may cover part of the fee, so could you send me an official invoice addressed to Parkview Logistics?
Thank you,
Daniel Okafor

questions.question: What is indicated about Lingua Bridge Institute's courses?
options: They are held only on weekends.
They last for ten weeks.
They include a free textbook.
They are offered in four languages.
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문(브로슈어)에서 'Classes meet twice a week for ten weeks'라고 명시되어 있으므로 수업이 10주간 진행된다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 수업은 주중 저녁(evening)에 주 2회 열리므로 (A)는 오답이고, 무료 교재나 4개 언어에 대한 언급은 없습니다. 4개로 나뉜 것은 언어가 아니라 레벨(levels)입니다.

questions.question: Which course will Mr. Okafor most likely take in the spring term?
options: Beginner (A1)
Elementary (A2)
Intermediate (B1)
Advanced (B2)
questions.explanation: 연계(이중 단서) 문제입니다. 세 번째 지문(이메일)에서 Okafor 씨는 'the course recommended in my result letter'에 등록하고 싶다고 했고, 두 번째 지문(배치고사 결과)에서 권장 과정은 Intermediate (B1)으로 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What discount does Mr. Okafor expect to receive on his summer tuition?
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 이메일에서 Okafor 씨는 여름 학기에도 계속 수강할 계획이며 '브로슈어에 언급된 할인'이 적용되는지 확인을 요청했습니다. 첫 번째 지문에서 두 학기를 연속 수강하면 두 번째 학기 수강료의 15%가 할인된다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: By what date must Mr. Okafor complete his enrollment?
options: February 18
February 25
March 2
March 9
questions.explanation: 브로슈어에서 봄 학기는 3월 9일에 시작하고 등록 마감은 3월 2일('enrollment closes on March 2')이라고 했으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 2월 18일은 배치고사 응시일, 2월 25일은 이메일 발송일, 3월 9일은 개강일입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Okafor request in his e-mail?
options: A transfer to an easier class
An extension of the test validity period
An invoice made out to his employer
A copy of the course syllabus
questions.explanation: 이메일 마지막 부분에서 회사가 수강료 일부를 부담할 수 있으니 'an official invoice addressed to Parkview Logistics'를 보내 달라고 요청했습니다. Parkview Logistics는 그의 고용주이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 쉬운 반으로의 이동은 결과지에 안내된 선택 사항일 뿐 그가 요청한 것이 아닙니다.

passage:
Request for Proposals — Office Multifunction Printers
Hartwell Insurance invites proposals for the supply and maintenance of 25 multifunction printers for its downtown headquarters. Proposals must include unit price, a minimum three-year on-site service warranty, and delivery within 30 days of contract signing. Vendors must submit proposals by e-mail to procurement@hartwellins.com no later than 5:00 P.M. on April 14. Late submissions will not be considered.

--- Passage 2 ---
Proposal Summary — Corvex Office Systems
Submitted: April 12
Unit price: $1,180 per printer (25 units)
Warranty: Four-year on-site service, parts and labor included
Delivery: Within 21 days of contract signing
Note: Corvex will also provide free staff training sessions during the first month and a 10% discount on toner cartridges ordered through our supply portal for the duration of the warranty.

--- Passage 3 ---
MEMO
To: Procurement Committee
From: Renata Vasquez, Purchasing Director
Date: April 21
Re: Printer vendor evaluation

We received four proposals by the deadline. One vendor was disqualified for offering only a two-year warranty. Of the remaining three, the committee recommends the vendor that offered the shortest delivery time, as our current lease expires at the end of May. Although this vendor's unit price was the second lowest, the longer warranty and the toner discount make its total cost of ownership the most attractive. I will draft the contract this week and aim to have the units installed before June 1.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the first document?
options: To announce a change in office location
To solicit bids from equipment suppliers
To explain how to operate a new printer
To advertise a printer sale to the public
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문은 Hartwell Insurance가 복합기 25대의 공급 및 유지보수를 위한 제안서(proposals)를 요청하는 RFP(입찰 공고)입니다. 'invites proposals for the supply and maintenance'라는 표현에서 공급업체로부터 입찰을 받으려는 목적임을 알 수 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is NOT mentioned as a requirement in the request for proposals?
options: A minimum warranty period
A delivery time frame
Submission by a deadline
An environmental certification
questions.explanation: NOT 문제입니다. RFP에는 최소 3년의 현장 서비스 보증(A), 계약 후 30일 이내 배송(B), 4월 14일 오후 5시까지 제출(C)이 모두 요구 사항으로 명시되어 있습니다. 환경 인증에 대한 언급은 없으므로 (D)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What can be concluded about Corvex Office Systems?
options: It submitted its proposal after the deadline.
It is the vendor the committee recommends.
It was disqualified from consideration.
It offered the lowest unit price.
questions.explanation: 세 지문을 모두 연계해야 하는 문제입니다. 메모에서 위원회는 '가장 짧은 배송 기간을 제시했고, 단가는 두 번째로 낮지만 더 긴 보증과 토너 할인'을 제공한 업체를 추천했습니다. 두 번째 지문에서 Corvex는 21일 배송, 4년 보증(요구된 3년보다 김), 토너 10% 할인을 제시했으므로 추천된 업체가 Corvex임을 추론할 수 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. Corvex는 4월 12일에 제출하여 마감(4월 14일)을 지켰고, 단가는 두 번째로 낮았다고 했으므로 (A), (D)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: According to the memo, why was one vendor disqualified?
options: Its proposal arrived late.
Its warranty period was too short.
Its unit price exceeded the budget.
It could not deliver within 30 days.
questions.explanation: 메모에서 'One vendor was disqualified for offering only a two-year warranty'라고 했습니다. RFP는 최소 3년 보증을 요구했는데 2년만 제시했기 때문에 탈락한 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Vasquez want the printers installed quickly?
options: A busy season begins in June.
The current equipment lease will end soon.
The company is hiring additional staff.
A government inspection is scheduled.
questions.explanation: 메모에서 'our current lease expires at the end of May'라고 하며 가장 짧은 배송 기간을 제시한 업체를 추천한 이유를 설명했습니다. 현재 장비 리스가 5월 말에 만료되기 때문에 6월 1일 전에 설치를 끝내려는 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Notice — Riverside 10K Charity Run: Route Information
The annual Riverside 10K Charity Run will take place on Saturday, May 16, starting at 8:00 A.M. at Compton Park. This year's route follows the river path north to Felton Bridge before returning along Garner Avenue. Please note that the final two kilometers include a steep climb up Hillcrest Road. Water stations will be located at the 3 km, 6 km, and 8 km marks. Teams of four or more receive a reduced entry fee of $20 per runner instead of the standard $28. All proceeds support the Riverside Children's Literacy Fund.

--- Passage 2 ---
Team Registration Form — Riverside 10K
Team name: Desk-to-Finish
Captain: Mira Chalhoub (m.chalhoub@vexlercorp.com)
Members: Mira Chalhoub, Tomas Reyes, Anita Gough, Devon Park, Lucy Tran
Entry fee paid: $100
T-shirt sizes: 2 M, 2 L, 1 S
Note: All runners must check in at the registration tent by 7:30 A.M. on race day.

--- Passage 3 ---
Team Chat — Desk-to-Finish
Mira Chalhoub [7:42 P.M.]: Reminder—race day is this Saturday! We need to be at the tent half an hour before the start.
Tomas Reyes [7:44 P.M.]: Got it. Should we carry our own water?
Mira Chalhoub [7:45 P.M.]: There are three stations on the course, so a small bottle is enough. But save some energy for the end—the notice says the last stretch is uphill.
Anita Gough [7:47 P.M.]: I just realized my shirt is a medium, but I ordered a small.
Mira Chalhoub [7:48 P.M.]: I'll ask at the tent if we can swap it. See everyone Saturday!

questions.question: What is suggested about the Desk-to-Finish team's entry fee?
options: It was paid at the standard individual rate.
It reflects the discounted team rate.
It includes an extra donation.
It will be refunded after the race.
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 공지에서 4인 이상 팀은 1인당 $28 대신 $20의 할인 요금이 적용된다고 했습니다. 등록 양식에서 팀원은 5명이고 납부 금액은 $100($20 × 5)이므로 할인된 팀 요금이 적용되었음을 알 수 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: By what time should team members arrive at the registration tent?
questions.explanation: 등록 양식에 'All runners must check in at the registration tent by 7:30 A.M.'이라고 명시되어 있고, 채팅에서도 Chalhoub 씨가 출발 30분 전(출발은 8시)까지 텐트에 도착해야 한다고 말했습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Chalhoub indicate about the end of the race course?
options: It passes over a bridge.
It involves an uphill section.
It has no water stations.
It finishes inside a stadium.
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 채팅에서 Chalhoub 씨는 'the notice says the last stretch is uphill'이라며 마지막 구간을 위해 힘을 아껴 두라고 했고, 이는 공지의 '마지막 2km는 Hillcrest Road의 가파른 오르막'이라는 내용과 일치합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 7:45 P.M., what does Ms. Chalhoub mean when she writes, "a small bottle is enough"?
options: Runners can rely partly on the course's water stations.
The race organizers prohibit large containers.
The team should share one bottle of water.
Bottled water will be sold at the finish line.
questions.explanation: 의도 파악 문제입니다. Reyes 씨가 물을 직접 가져가야 하는지 묻자, Chalhoub 씨는 코스에 급수대가 세 곳 있으므로 작은 물병이면 충분하다고 답했습니다. 즉, 코스의 급수대를 이용할 수 있으니 많은 물을 가져갈 필요가 없다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What problem does Ms. Gough mention?
options: She cannot attend the race on Saturday.
She received the wrong size T-shirt.
She has not paid her entry fee.
She lost her registration confirmation.
questions.explanation: 채팅에서 Gough 씨는 'my shirt is a medium, but I ordered a small'이라고 하여 주문한 사이즈(S)와 다른 사이즈(M)의 티셔츠를 받았다는 문제를 언급했습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답이며, Chalhoub 씨가 텐트에서 교환 가능한지 문의하겠다고 답했습니다.

passage:
Brentmoor Hotel — Conference Package
Our Silver Conference Package ($45 per person, minimum 30 guests) includes use of the Lakeview Hall from 9:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M., a projector and sound system, morning coffee service, and a buffet lunch. Optional add-ons: afternoon tea service ($6 per person) and on-site parking vouchers ($8 per vehicle). A 20% deposit is required to confirm a booking; the balance is billed after the event. Cancellations made fewer than seven days in advance forfeit the deposit.

--- Passage 2 ---
Banquet Event Order — Brentmoor Hotel
Client: Ostrander Financial Group (contact: Priya Nair)
Event date: Thursday, October 8
Package: Silver Conference Package — 40 guests
Add-ons: Afternoon tea service for 40; parking vouchers for 12 vehicles
Dietary notes: 4 vegetarian, 2 gluten-free lunches
Deposit received: September 15

--- Passage 3 ---
INVOICE #20488 — Brentmoor Hotel
Bill to: Ostrander Financial Group
Event date: October 8
Silver Conference Package: 40 guests x $45 = $1,800
Afternoon tea service: 40 x $6 = $240
Parking vouchers: 15 x $8 = $120
Subtotal: $2,160
Less deposit paid: -$432
Balance due: $1,728
Payment due within 30 days. Please direct questions to accounts@brentmoorhotel.com.
Note: Three additional parking vouchers were issued at the front desk on the day of the event at the client's request.

questions.question: What is included in the Silver Conference Package?
options: Overnight accommodations
A buffet lunch
Airport shuttle service
Afternoon tea service
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문에서 Silver Conference Package에는 홀 사용, 프로젝터와 음향 시스템, 모닝 커피 서비스, 뷔페 점심(buffet lunch)이 포함된다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 오후 티 서비스는 패키지에 포함된 것이 아니라 유료 추가 옵션이므로 (D)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What amount did Ostrander Financial Group pay on September 15?
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 행사 주문서에 9월 15일 보증금(deposit)이 수령되었다고 했고, 패키지 안내문에서 보증금은 20%라고 했습니다. 송장에서 'Less deposit paid: -$432'로 확인되며, 이는 소계 $2,160의 20%에 해당합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: How does the invoice differ from the original banquet event order?
options: More parking vouchers were charged.
Fewer guests attended the lunch.
The tea service was canceled.
The room rental fee was increased.
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 행사 주문서에는 주차권 12매가 기재되어 있었지만, 송장에는 15매(15 x $8 = $120)가 청구되었습니다. 송장 하단의 메모에서 행사 당일 고객 요청으로 3매가 추가 발급되었다고 설명하고 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 게스트 수(40명)와 티 서비스(40인분)는 주문서와 동일합니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the hotel's cancellation policy?
options: Cancellations must be made in writing.
A late cancellation results in the loss of the deposit.
Clients may reschedule once at no charge.
Full refunds are available within 30 days.
questions.explanation: 패키지 안내문에서 'Cancellations made fewer than seven days in advance forfeit the deposit'이라고 했습니다. 행사 7일 전 이내에 취소하면 보증금을 돌려받지 못한다는 의미이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about the October 8 event?
options: It ended later than 5:00 P.M.
It was attended by fewer than 30 guests.
Some attendees required special meals.
It was moved to a different hall.
questions.explanation: 행사 주문서의 'Dietary notes: 4 vegetarian, 2 gluten-free lunches'에서 일부 참석자가 채식 및 글루텐 프리 등 특별식을 요청했음을 알 수 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 게스트는 40명으로 최소 인원(30명)을 넘었고, 종료 시간이나 홀 변경에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

passage:
Kestrel Media — Staff Handbook, Section 7: Remote Work
Employees who have completed their six-month probationary period may apply to work remotely up to two days per week. Requests must be approved by the employee's direct supervisor and renewed every quarter. Remote workdays may not be scheduled on Mondays, when all-staff meetings are held. Equipment for home use, including laptops, must be requested through the IT Department at least five business days in advance.

--- Passage 2 ---
To: hr@kestrelmedia.com
From: jswanson@kestrelmedia.com
Date: July 7
Subject: Remote work question

Hello,
I joined the design team on March 2 of this year and would like to begin working from home on Tuesdays and Fridays. My supervisor, Elena Petrov, has already told me she supports the idea. Could you confirm when I am allowed to start and what I need to do about getting a laptop? I would like my first remote day to be Tuesday, September 8.
Best regards,
Jonah Swanson

--- Passage 3 ---
To: jswanson@kestrelmedia.com
From: hr@kestrelmedia.com
Date: July 8
Subject: RE: Remote work question

Dear Mr. Swanson,
Thank you for your inquiry. Based on your start date, you will become eligible on September 2, so the start date you proposed will work. Since Ms. Petrov has agreed, simply have her submit the approval form, and remember that it must be resubmitted each quarter. Regarding equipment, please file your request with the appropriate department no later than September 1 to ensure your laptop is ready. One further note: the handbook restriction on scheduling does not affect either of the days you selected.
Regards,
Felicia Mbeki, Human Resources

questions.question: According to the handbook, how often must remote work approval be renewed?
options: Every month
Every quarter
Twice a year
Once a year
questions.explanation: 직원 핸드북에서 재택근무 신청은 직속 상사의 승인을 받아야 하며 'renewed every quarter', 즉 분기마다 갱신해야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. HR 답장에서도 매 분기 다시 제출해야 한다고 재확인하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why is September 2 significant for Mr. Swanson?
options: It is the date of an all-staff meeting.
It is the deadline for an equipment request.
It is when his probationary period ends.
It is when his supervisor returns from leave.
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 핸드북에서 6개월의 수습 기간을 마친 직원만 재택근무를 신청할 수 있다고 했고, Swanson 씨는 이메일에서 3월 2일에 입사했다고 밝혔습니다. HR은 'Based on your start date, you will become eligible on September 2'라고 답했는데, 이는 입사 후 6개월이 되어 수습 기간이 끝나는 시점이기 때문입니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is Mr. Swanson advised to do by September 1?
options: Submit a request to the IT Department
Attend a remote work orientation
Sign a revised employment contract
Return his current laptop
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. HR 답장에서 장비 요청을 'the appropriate department'에 9월 1일까지 제출하라고 했고, 핸드북에 따르면 노트북 등 가정용 장비는 IT 부서에 최소 5영업일 전에 요청해야 합니다. 따라서 9월 1일까지 IT 부서에 요청서를 제출하라는 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Mbeki imply about Mondays?
options: They are the busiest days for the IT Department.
Mr. Swanson did not choose them as remote workdays.
All-staff meetings will soon be moved to Mondays.
They are reserved for client presentations.
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 추론 문제입니다. 핸드북에서 전 직원 회의가 열리는 월요일에는 재택근무를 할 수 없다고 했습니다. Mbeki 씨는 'the handbook restriction on scheduling does not affect either of the days you selected'라고 했는데, Swanson 씨가 선택한 요일은 화요일과 금요일로 월요일이 아니기 때문에 제한이 적용되지 않는다는 의미입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What must Ms. Petrov do for Mr. Swanson's request to proceed?
options: Provide him with a company laptop
Submit an approval form
Schedule a meeting with Human Resources
Revise the staff handbook
questions.explanation: HR 답장에서 'simply have her submit the approval form'이라고 했습니다. Petrov 씨는 Swanson 씨의 직속 상사로서 승인 양식을 제출해야 하므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 노트북 지급은 IT 부서의 역할입니다.

passage:

Join us for a guided walking tour of our hillside vineyard followed by a tasting of five estate wines. Tours run Friday through Sunday at 11:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M., April to October. Family session (60 min, 8 retouched images): $180
Corporate team session (on location, up to 15 staff): $450
All sessions include an online gallery within five business days. Rescheduling is free with at least 48 hours' notice; later changes incur a $25 fee. Saturday appointments fill quickly—book at least three weeks ahead.

--- Passage 2 ---
Booking Confirmation — Halverson Portrait Studio
Client: Nadia Rezaei
Session: Headshot session
Date/Time: Saturday, March 21, 10:00 A.M.
Location: Studio A, 310 Whitlock Avenue
Amount paid: $95
Note: Please arrive 10 minutes early. Bring two outfit options; solid colors photograph best.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: bookings@halversonstudio.com
From: n.rezaei@trovamail.com
Date: Thursday, March 19, 9:15 A.M.
Subject: Appointment change request

Hello,
I'm scheduled for this Saturday morning, but I've just been asked to attend an urgent client meeting that day. Could I move my session to the following Saturday, March 28, at the same time? I'm aware of your policy regarding short-notice changes, and based on when I'm sending this, I believe my request still qualifies for free rescheduling—please confirm. Also, my new business cards will feature the photos, so could the retouched images be delivered sooner than the standard time frame? I'd be happy to pay a rush fee if necessary.
Thank you,
Nadia Rezaei

questions.question: What is indicated about Halverson Portrait Studio?
options: It is closed on weekends.
Its Saturday slots are in high demand.
It offers only outdoor sessions.
It provides free parking for clients.
questions.explanation: 웹페이지에서 'Saturday appointments fill quickly—book at least three weeks ahead'라고 했습니다. 토요일 예약이 빨리 차므로 수요가 많다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 토요일에도 영업하므로 (A)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: How many retouched images is Ms. Rezaei entitled to receive?
options: Two
Five
Eight
Fifteen
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 예약 확인서에서 Rezaei 씨의 예약은 Headshot session이고, 웹페이지에서 헤드샷 세션에는 보정 사진 2장(2 retouched images)이 포함된다고 했습니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 8장은 가족 세션에 해당합니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Rezaei believe she will not be charged a fee?
options: She is a returning customer.
Her request was sent more than 48 hours before her session.
The studio canceled her original appointment.
She purchased a premium package.
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 추론 문제입니다. 웹페이지 정책에 따르면 48시간 전까지 통지하면 무료로 일정을 변경할 수 있습니다. 그녀의 세션은 토요일(3월 21일) 오전 10시이고 이메일은 목요일(3월 19일) 오전 9시 15분에 발송되어 48시간 이상 남았으므로 무료 변경 요건을 충족합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Rezaei need her photographs quickly?
options: They will appear on her business cards.
She is submitting them with a job application.
Her company website launches soon.
She is entering a photography contest.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'my new business cards will feature the photos'라며 보정 사진을 표준 기한보다 빨리 받을 수 있는지 물었습니다. 새 명함에 사진이 들어가기 때문이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is the standard time frame Ms. Rezaei refers to in her e-mail?
options: Two business days
Three weeks
Five business days
Ten business days
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 이메일에서 그녀는 'the standard time frame'보다 빨리 사진을 받고 싶다고 했고, 웹페이지에서 모든 세션은 5영업일 이내에 온라인 갤러리를 제공한다('online gallery within five business days')고 했습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 3주는 토요일 예약 권장 시점입니다.

passage:
Meadowfork Farm Co-op — June Newsletter
Summer is here, and our weekly harvest boxes are overflowing! Members can choose the Garden Box ($24 per week) or the Orchard Box ($32 per week), which adds seasonal fruit. Boxes are packed every Thursday and can be picked up at the farm stand or delivered within Dunmore County for a $5 fee. New this season: members may pause their subscription for up to three weeks per quarter through their online account. When a listed item is unavailable due to weather or low yield, we substitute it with produce of equal or greater value and notify members by e-mail.

--- Passage 2 ---
Meadowfork Farm Co-op — Subscription Form
Name: Carl Eastwick
Box type: Orchard Box
Start date: June 5
Fulfillment: Delivery — 75 Birchwood Drive, Dunmore County
Weekly total: $37
Payment: Monthly, by automatic bank transfer
Special instructions: Leave the box on the side porch if no one answers the door.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: c.eastwick@plummail.net
From: notices@meadowfork.coop
Date: Thursday, June 19
Subject: A change to this week's box

Dear Member,
Due to a week of heavy rain, the strawberries listed for this week's Orchard Box could not be harvested. In their place, you will receive two jars of our farm-made strawberry preserves, which sell for $6 more than the berries at our farm stand. There is no additional charge. Your box is on the truck and will arrive today as scheduled. We appreciate your understanding and expect strawberries to return next week.
— The Meadowfork Team

questions.question: What is a new feature mentioned in the newsletter?
options: A discounted annual membership
The option to suspend deliveries temporarily
A second weekly packing day
Organic certification for all produce
questions.explanation: 뉴스레터에서 'New this season: members may pause their subscription for up to three weeks per quarter'라고 했습니다. 분기당 최대 3주까지 구독을 일시 중지할 수 있는 기능이 새로 생겼으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why is Mr. Eastwick's weekly total $37?
options: He chose the Garden Box with fruit added.
His payment includes a late fee.
He pays for the Orchard Box plus delivery.
He subscribed before the price increase.
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 뉴스레터에서 Orchard Box는 주당 $32이고 Dunmore County 내 배송비는 $5입니다. 구독 양식에서 Eastwick 씨는 Orchard Box를 선택하고 배송(Delivery)을 신청했으므로 $32 + $5 = $37이 됩니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to the e-mail, why were strawberries unavailable?
options: An unusually large number of orders
A period of heavy rainfall
A delay at a packing facility
An early end to the growing season
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'Due to a week of heavy rain, the strawberries ... could not be harvested'라고 했습니다. 일주일간의 폭우로 딸기를 수확할 수 없었기 때문이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: How does the substitution comply with the co-op's stated policy?
options: The replacement item is worth more than the original.
Members were given the choice of a refund.
The box was delivered a day early.
The substitution was approved by a member vote.
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 뉴스레터의 정책에 따르면 품목이 준비되지 않을 경우 '동등하거나 더 높은 가치의 농산물로 대체하고 이메일로 알린다'고 했습니다. 이메일에서 대체품인 딸기잼 두 병은 딸기보다 $6 더 비싸게 판매되는 제품이고 추가 요금도 없으며 이메일로 통지되었으므로 정책에 부합합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What will most likely happen if Mr. Eastwick is not home when his box arrives on June 19?
options: The box will be returned to the farm stand.
The driver will leave the box on the side porch.
Delivery will be attempted again the next day.
He will be asked to pick it up within 24 hours.
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 구독 양식의 특별 지시 사항에 '아무도 응답하지 않으면 상자를 옆 현관에 두라(Leave the box on the side porch)'고 적혀 있습니다. 이메일에서 상자가 오늘(6월 19일) 예정대로 배송된다고 했으므로, 부재 시 기사는 지시대로 옆 현관에 상자를 둘 것입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.
